decision_caption: Decision 3017E - Chino Valley Unified School District EMPLOYER INTERFERENCE, RESTRAINT, COERCION, EMPLOYER CONDUCT AFFECTING ORGANIZING,
title: Headnote for 3017E, 401.04000 Access – Union Right
text: School district’s ban on the display of “flags,” broadly defined, encompassed union insignia and thus interfered with union’s right to communicate with employees with posters, fliers, newsletters, or other graphic or printed materials containing union insignia. (pp. 24-25.)
